root_cause: The custom mark was emitted in a separate run and the footnote body also contained w:footnoteRef plus literal text. Word-authored custom footnotes instead place w:footnoteReference and the literal custom mark in the same run, and use only literal marker text in the footnote body.

word_authored_contract.main_text: one run containing w:footnoteReference customMarkFollows=1 followed by one w:t custom marker
word_authored_contract.footnote_body: one styled w:t custom marker; no w:footnoteRef

remaining_layout_limitations: The generic experimental serializer renders 15 Word pages versus 7 source PDF pages.
Native footnotes follow their anchors to the bottom of the rendered Word page, but source-exact pagination is outside the footnote-only scope.
Final interactive Word inspection is still required before using this experimental file downstream.
